 done=subprocess.run(['perf','report','--stdio','-i',str(raw),'--no-children','--sort','symbol','--call-graph','none','--percent-limit','0.5'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 rawreport=root/f'artifacts/accept-fairness-profile-{role}-flat-final.txt';rawreport.write_text(done.stdout)

 lost=int(re.search(r'Total Lost Samples: (\d+)',done.stdout).group(1));samples=int(re.search(r'\((\d+) samples\)',data['perf_log']).group(1))
 assert lost==0 and data['perf_exit_code'] in [0,-2]
 record['cases'].append({'kind':role,'server_sha256':data['server_sha256'],'samples':samples,'lost':lost,'trace':desc(trace),'raw_data':desc(raw),'raw_report':desc(rawreport),'published_report':desc(published),'server_cpu_times':data['mixed']['server_cpu_times'],'server_cpu_seconds':data['mixed']['server_cpu_seconds'],'user_seconds_fraction':data['mixed']['server_cpu_times']['user']/data['mixed']['server_cpu_seconds']})
record['passed']=True
(bench/'2026-10-16-accept-fairness-profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([{'kind':c['kind'],'samples':c['samples'],'lost':c['lost'],'cpu_times':c['server_cpu_times']} for c in record['cases']]))
